priority: execution time first, whole-process RSS second

protocol.cache: Uncontrolled OS cache; fixture generation/identity checks warm inputs; one serial warmup per case by default; not cold-cache measurements

cache.gate: independent fresh-child mincore; zero MINCORE_INCORE pages in every input
cache.scope: full unchanged public call; source hashing can warm inputs before decoding
cache.startup: fresh Python process; startup and cache preparation excluded from timing

commands.name: 06-python-tests

commands.name: 07-ruff
commands.command: .venv/bin/ruff check python research tests benchmarks scripts

final_acceptance.report_text: Final acceptance passed on local main at 8e2b70b, with production change 2b53b01 retained. Rust formatting, Clippy with warnings denied, 42 Rust workspace tests, the explicitly enabled real-sample ingestion test, and the same 42 workspace tests on Rust 1.90.0 passed. The standard workspace and MSRV commands each leave only the externally supplied sample test ignored; that test passed separately with the delivered sample. All 114 Python API, native integration, research, real-sample and benchmark tests passed without skips. Ruff, strict mypy over seven source files, git diff --check, locked offline release-wheel construction and a fresh isolated wheel installation outside the checkout passed. The isolated smoke exercised native Parquet I/O, typed error mapping, package typing files, CLI and installed research helpers. At 1, 5, 10, 30 and 60 seconds, accepted row counts were respectively 45,966, 8,985, 4,390, 1,382 and 650. Keys, all nine integer columns, average depth and quality flags matched exactly. Maximum absolute price-change errors across all widths were 2.1827852025868566e-13 dollars and 2.1827872842550278e-11 ticks, below tolerances 1e-10 and 1e-8; average-depth error was zero against tolerance 1e-10. All 24 delivery hashes, both raw ZIP archive hashes and sizes, paired raw CSV counts of 301,587 AAPL and 595,800 MSFT rows, and the delivered 887,810 clean-event/68,404 trade/897,387 quality-row counts were verified. The installed compiled native extension remained a4bbe9c69622920b9e6f589ea73ff66f0ac8f497cb5993f54789eeba15507d35 before and after acceptance; all 39 source hashes remained identical to the regular, full warm and cold evidence. The wheel build did not replace the installed extension. The tracked working tree remained clean, and this validation created only ignored evidence files. No implementation commits were pushed. The first isolated-wheel attempt failed because the sandbox could not reach the package index; the unchanged helper passed after network escalation.

limitations: Host/cache activity uncontrolled; no universal performance guarantee.
Cold means independently verified zero input-page residency before worker setup; physical-device cache is unverified and timed source hashing warms inputs.
Final warm RSS medians and maximum increased; no stable overall memory reduction.
t1-c4096 and t4-c65536 change both thread cap and chunk size.
